card.name: Small words in math and science prose
card.fires_on: Short linking words (the, is, of, a, so) inside technical math, statistics or physics text, often right after a defined term such as 'complex geometry' or 'cardinality'.

modes.label: Verb or article after a math term
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'the' follows a technical subject in a definition-style sentence.

modes.label: Inside technical noun phrases
modes.description: Part of a technical phrase in physics or statistics, such as 'quantum mechanics' or 'Telecommunications'.
modes.example: the randomness of a quantum<< mechanics>> fundamental quantity,7,8 circuit chaos
